name_en: Oname — a fermented barley-and-soybean relish eaten with rice
summary_ja: 麦こうじと大豆で作る発酵食品で、冷蔵すれば半年ほど日持ちする常備菜。秩父地域を中心に伝わり、塩漬けのなすやしいたけを混ぜ込んで、夏の食欲がない時期にも食が進む。
summary_en: A fermented relish of barley malt and soybeans that keeps for months in the fridge, a pantry staple centered on Chichibu. Salted eggplant or shiitake are mixed in, and its saltiness coaxes appetite through the summer heat.
source_title: おなめ｜うちの郷土料理｜農林水産省
